title: Palmer Penguins
text: This dataset comes from the TidyTuesday project (week of July 28, 2020). It includes body measurements for three species of penguins Adelie, Chinstrap, and Gentoo that live on islands in the Palmer Archipelago, Antarctica. The plot below looks at the relationship between flipper length and body mass.

title: Palmer Penguins
text: This dataset comes from the TidyTuesday project (week of July 28, 2020). It includes body measurements for three species of penguins Adelie, Chinstrap, and Gentoo that live on islands in the Palmer Archipelago, Antarctica. The plot below looks at the relationship between flipper length and body mass.

title: Palmer Penguins
text:
Plot

library(tidyverse)

penguins <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2020/2020-07-28/penguins.csv')

penguins |>
  drop_na(flipper_length_mm, body_mass_g) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = flipper_length_mm, y = body_mass_g, color = species)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(
    title = "Flipper Length vs. Body Mass in Palmer Penguins",
    x = "Flipper length (mm)",
    y = "Body mass (g)",
    color = "Species"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
